items: Before working on the fuel system, disconnect the negative terminal from the battery.
When working on the fuel system, do not smoke or work near any fire.
Keep gasoline off rubber or leather parts.

content.text: Any diagnosis code retained by the computer will be cleared when the battery terminal is removed. Therefore, if necessary, read the diagnosis before removing the battery terminal.

subitems: (b) Insure proper connection of battery terminals, etc.
(d) After repair work, insure that the ignition coil terminals and all other ignition system lines are reconnected securely.
(e) When cleaning the engine compartment, be especially careful to protect the electrical system from water.
(a) Do not allow oxygen sensor to drop or hit against an object.
(b) Do not allow water to come into contact with the sensor or attempt to cool it.
